Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: DataVerification_Expert made the first mistake by incorrectly assuming that the first citation reference link on Carl Nebel's Wikipedia page led directly to the MFAH collection page. Instead, the code execution showed that the extracted first citation link was "https://en.wikipedia.org#cite_note-thb-1", which is not a direct link to the MFAH collection page. This incorrect assumption led to an incorrect image URL being fetched and subsequently caused the OCR process to fail due to an UnidentifiedImageError. This error occurred because the URL obtained was not a direct link to an image, but rather a link to the Wikipedia page itself or an unrelated image, leading to a failure in the image identification process.
